title: Smith et al. 2011, MNRAS 412, 1522 — Observed fractions of core-collapse supernova types (LOSS volume-limited sample, within 60 Mpc)
content: Table 1 lists volume-limited core-collapse SN fractions from the LOSS sample within 60 Mpc; the entry for Type IIb is 'IIb: 10.6 +3.6/-3.1' (percent).
